categories.main_business_segments: Gurunavi, Inc. operates primarily in the restaurant promotion support business, centered on its online restaurant information platform 'Rakuten Gurunavi.' The company provides information and reservation services for restaurants, business support services for restaurant management, and related promotional activities. Additional segments include promotional services for food and beverage manufacturers and local governments, as well as related businesses such as inbound tourism information, e-commerce, and restaurant floor development.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include web-based information platforms, online reservation systems, customer and reservation management tools, and mobile ordering solutions (e.g., Gurunavi FineOrder). It leverages data analytics for access and customer behavior, supports multi-language content, and integrates with external platforms like Google Business Profile and social media. The company is also investing in AI-driven personalization and digital transformation (DX) tools for restaurant operations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Gurunavi primarily serves restaurants and dining establishments across Japan, ranging from small independent operators to large chains. Its end users are consumers seeking restaurant information and reservations, as well as food and beverage manufacturers and local governments for promotional activities. The company also targets inbound tourists through multilingual services and tourism information platforms.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's main operations are in Japan, with a nationwide presence through its online platform and regional offices. It also has a subsidiary in Shanghai for Japanese food promotion in China and provides inbound tourism information services targeting foreign visitors to Japan. Over 90% of revenue is generated from domestic Japanese customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Gurunavi operates downstream in the supply chain, directly interfacing with restaurants and end consumers. It acts as a marketing and business support intermediary, connecting restaurants with diners and providing value-added services to both sides.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening the 'Rakuten Gurunavi' platform, expanding marketing agent services to support diverse restaurant promotional needs, and enhancing digital transformation (DX) offerings such as mobile ordering. The company is also focusing on AI-driven personalization, leveraging data assets, and developing new business models in food supply optimization and regional revitalization. Collaboration with Rakuten and other partners is emphasized for ecosystem growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily from restaurants through membership fees, online reservation commissions, and service usage fees. Additional income comes from promotional services for manufacturers and local governments, consulting fees, e-commerce sales commissions, and paid membership programs for consumers. The model combines recurring (stock-type) and transactional (spot-type) revenues.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include other major restaurant information and reservation platforms in Japan, such as Tabelog and Hot Pepper Gourmet, as well as global platforms like Google and TripAdvisor. Gurunavi positions itself as a leading domestic player with strong B2B relationships, a comprehensive support system for restaurants, and a strategic alliance with Rakuten for ecosystem integration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated sales were approximately 13.46 billion yen, with a return to profitability (net income of 211 million yen) after several years of losses. The company has around 749 employees and is in a phase of moderate revenue growth (+3.7% YoY), with a focus on stabilizing and expanding its core business following a successful turnaround to profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Gurunavi differentiates itself through its comprehensive support for restaurant management, combining digital tools with strong human support (sales and consulting staff). Its unique value lies in its ability to drive customer traffic to restaurants, provide multi-channel marketing support, and offer tailored solutions for operational efficiency. The strategic partnership with Rakuten enhances its ecosystem value, loyalty programs, and access to a large user base.
